questions.question: Foundation A metal block has a mass of 2.7 kg and a volume of 0.001 m³. Calculate its density in kg/m³.
questions.correctAnswer: ρ = m / V = 2.7 / 0.001 = 2700 kg/m³ (this is aluminium)
